objective_value: <float> Total penalty incurred from carousel utilization exceeding the target across all carousels, threshold levels, and peak intervals.

assignments.flight_id: <int> Identifier of the flight being scheduled.
assignments.carousel_id: <int> Identifier of the carousel chosen to handle this flight's baggage.
assignments.carousel_type: <int> Type of the chosen carousel, which determines its capacity characteristics.
assignments.working_stations: <int> Number of working stations allocated to this flight at the chosen carousel.
assignments.handling_start_period: <int> Period in which baggage handling for this flight begins at the carousel.
assignments.depletion_start_period: <int> Period in which transfer of this flight's bags from central storage to the carousel begins.
assignments.end_period: <int> Period by which baggage handling for this flight must conclude.

utilization_violations.carousel_id: <int> Identifier of the carousel whose utilization exceeded the target during the peak interval.
utilization_violations.peak_interval: <int> Identifier of the peak interval in which the utilization overshoot is flagged.
utilization_violations.threshold_level: <int> Index of the threshold level flagged as exceeded for this carousel and peak interval.
utilization_violations.threshold_value: <float> Value of the flagged threshold used as the allowable overshoot above the target utilization.
